title: PATCH /api/projects/[projectId] request body
description: Shape only. input_values[*].state is deliberately unconstrained: its own check answers 400 (src/domain/project-edits.ts:108-109).

input_values.description: Free-form input ids, except the prototype keys: the domain assigns next.input_values[inputId] (src/domain/project-edits.ts:134), so a request must not be able to set a prototype.

state.description: Unconstrained on purpose: the domain owns the state vocabulary and answers 400.
